verdict.rationale: Brex exposes a full REST API with token-based auth (no interactive login required), webhook subscriptions, and Postman/Zapier/Workato/Pipedream automation examples (bulk card creation, scheduled exports), all of which support headless, non-interactive use suitable for scripted/CI-style automation. However there is no explicit mention of CI/CD pipelines, SDKs, or headless test/deploy tooling — missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, official SDKs for scripting, and confirmation of non-interactive token refresh/rotation suitable for unattended pipelines.
